description:
## 1.36.0-dev.111 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: resolve comment focus only from Android's active Compose host, avoiding stale targets from older post layers.
- Reddit: refresh the live comment target when O is pressed so the tint and collapsed comment stay aligned.
- Reddit: discard delayed indicator updates from older rapid keyboard presses.
- Reddit: stop treating words such as profile or options inside post and comment content as navigation chrome.
- Reddit: leave P preview behavior unchanged.
